:::{#def-fitted-model}
#### Fitted model

A **fitted model** $\emodmem$ is a member of a [model family](#def-model-family) $\modelfam$
that has been chosen to describe a [data set](#def-data-set) $\dataset$.

:::

:::{#rem-source-fitted-model}
#### Source: Fitted model

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.2] write the model estimated from a training set as $\hat f$.

:::
